recordText: From the 1660s, meaning elegant, stylish. It was an imperfect, perhaps joking attempt to say French *gentil* the way the French did. By the 1670s it also meant easy and sprightly.
gossipText: The third version of Gentle, and the only one having fun. Owes his whole existence to an accent.
testimony: Then a French translator cast him as the jinni in the Arabian Nights, because the two words happened to sound alike. Pure accident. He kept the costume.
